svg.title: Neuro-Screen: a negative result, reported straight
svg.desc: After removing target leakage, leakage-free 5-fold nested cross-validation gives 62.1 percent cognitive accuracy, equal to the majority baseline, and ROC-AUC 0.48 against a chance level of 0.50. 2,236 respondents, 12 predictors, a 4-model stack.
svg.text: Found target leakage, removed it, and
reported what the clean model really does.
AIUB group project · app and re-analysis are my work
